correctness.rationale: The witness proof is symbolic: \(\rho>2\) and symmetry imply eigenvector maximum at vertex \(3\), while the exact PageRank differences \(p_0-p_1\), \(p_0-p_3\), and \(p_0-p_4\) are positive throughout \(\alpha\in(0,1)\). All connected graph isomorphism classes through five vertices are exhaustively generated; exact PageRank crossing roots and exact Perron-coordinate comparisons rule out an earlier unique-max conflict.

value.rationale: PageRank and adjacency-eigenvector centrality are canonical recursive network-importance measures with different normalization mechanisms. The exact minimum unique-top conflict is a natural structural benchmark, and the witness is stronger than a parameter-specific example because the disagreement persists for every nontrivial damping value.
